title: Maximum scan of a formula
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean word and let $\varphi$ be a CNF formula over natural-number-indexed variables. If $x$ is a concatenation of a prefix, the serialization of $\varphi$, and a suffix, then for every counter length $n$, second-tape content, second-tape head position $b$, and output word $o$, there is a number of steps $t\le 2|\mathrm{enc}(\varphi)|$ after which the machine is in state $7$ at input position $|\mathrm{pre}|+|\mathrm{enc}(\varphi)|-1$. Its counter length is $\max(n,N(\varphi))$, where $N(\varphi)$ is one more than the largest variable index occurring in the formula, or $0$ if none occurs; the counter head remains at $0$, and the second tape, its head, and the output are unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: decomposition of $x$ as prefix, serialized formula, and suffix
replaced:
Let $\varphi$ be a CNF formula with serialization $\mathrm{ser}(\varphi)$ and
its variable bound $N(\varphi)$ (one more than the largest variable index occurring in $\varphi$, or $0$ if no variable occurs). Suppose the input is
$x = p \mathbin{+\!\!+} \mathrm{ser}(\varphi) \mathbin{+\!\!+} r$, and the
transducer is in formula-level maximum control at input position $|p|$, with
counter length $n$, counter head at $0$, and arbitrary buffer, buffer head, and
output. Then there is a number $t \le 2\,|\mathrm{ser}(\varphi)|$ of silent steps
after which the transducer is at its rewind seam at input position
$|p| + |\mathrm{ser}(\varphi)| - 1$, with counter length $\max(n, N(\varphi))$,
counter head at $0$, and buffer, buffer head, and output unchanged.
